modules.title: Introduction to Complexity Theory - Basic concepts and motiv
modules.topics: Introduction to Complexity Theory - Basic concepts and motivations, Deterministic and nondeterministic models, Turing machines, and computational models. (Text 2 - Ch 7) Complexity Classes P and NP - Definitions and examples of P and NP, Polynomial-time algorithms, NP-completeness and the Cook-Levin theorem. (Text 2 - Ch 7, 8) Reductions and Completeness - Polynomial-time reductions, NP-complete problems, and their significance, Examples of NP-complete problems (Text 1 - Ch 2)

modules.title: Space Complexity - Space complexity classes
modules.topics: Space Complexity - Space complexity classes: L, NL, PSPACE, Savitch's theorem and NL-completeness, PSPACE-completeness. (Text 2 - Ch 8) Polynomial Hierarchy and Alternation - Definition of the polynomial hierarchy (PH), Complete problems for each level of PH, Relationship between PH and other classes. (Text 1 - Ch 5)

modules.topics: Interactive Proofs - Definition and examples of interactive proofs, IP =

modules.title: Circuit Complexity - Boolean circuits and circuit complexity
modules.topics: Circuit Complexity - Boolean circuits and circuit complexity, Circuit lower bounds, Complexity of specific functions. (Text 2 - Ch 9) Quantum Complexity - Basics of quantum computation, Quantum complexity classes: BQP, QMA, Quantum algorithms and their complexity. (Text 3 - Ch 10, 11)
